title: Grade 6 French — Mon, Jun 16
description: La nourriture — Day 1 of 5: Food vocabulary
subject: french

questions.question: Which of the following is the French word for 'apple'?
questions.explanation: La pomme means apple in French. La poire = pear, l'orange = orange, la fraise = strawberry.

questions.question: What does 'les légumes' mean in English?
questions.explanation: Les légumes means vegetables. Les fruits = fruits, les viandes = meats, les boissons = drinks.

questions.question: Which food item is 'une tomate'?
questions.explanation: Une tomate is a tomato. Une pomme de terre = potato, une carotte = carrot, un oignon = onion.

questions.question: The French word 'le poulet' refers to which food?
questions.explanation: Le poulet means chicken. Le poisson = fish, le bœuf = beef, l'agneau = lamb.

questions.question: What is 'une banane' in English?
questions.explanation: Une banane is a banana. Une mangue = mango, un raisin = grape, un citron = lemon.

questions.question: Which of these is a vegetable (légume) in French?
questions.explanation: Une carotte (carrot) is a vegetable. Une pêche = peach, une cerise = cherry, une fraise = strawberry — these are all fruits.

questions.question: What does 'la viande' mean?
questions.explanation: La viande means meat. Le pain = bread, le poisson = fish, le légume = vegetable.

questions.question: The French word for 'grapes' is:
questions.explanation: Les raisins means grapes. Les cerises = cherries, les fraises = strawberries, les poires = pears.

questions.question: Which of the following is 'le bœuf'?
questions.explanation: Le bœuf means beef. Le porc = pork, l'agneau = lamb, le poulet = chicken.

questions.question: What is 'un oignon'?
questions.explanation: Un oignon is an onion. L'ail = garlic, une pomme de terre = potato, une tomate = tomato.

questions.question: Which food group does 'le poisson' belong to?
questions.explanation: Le poisson (fish) belongs to the viandes/poissons (meat/fish) food group.

questions.question: What does 'les fruits' mean in English?
questions.explanation: Les fruits simply means 'the fruits' in English.

questions.question: The French word for 'potato' is:
questions.explanation: La pomme de terre (literally 'apple of the earth') means potato. La carotte = carrot, le navet = turnip, l'oignon = onion.

questions.question: Which of these is a fruit (un fruit)?
questions.explanation: Une mangue (mango) is a fruit. Un haricot vert = green bean, un poivron = bell pepper, un champignon = mushroom — these are vegetables.

questions.question: What is 'le pain' in English?
questions.explanation: Le pain means bread. Le gâteau = cake, le riz = rice, les pâtes = pasta.
